programmes.programName: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in the Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering
programmes.department: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering
programmes.evidence: Official institute department page names Industrial and Systems Engineering and explicitly says the department offers Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) programmes. The rolling PhD admissions brochure lists this department among current academic units for the institute PhD.
limitations: PhD is awarded by the institute through the named department; the page does not establish a separately titled Industrial Engineering degree.

branches.conclusion: Official Vinod Gupta School of Management full PhD overview confirms a management PhD awarded by IIT Kharagpur. The page does not name a formal Operations or Management Science doctoral field; other formal business doctoral inventory remains to check.

Current institute rolling PhD brochure and full Industrial and Systems Engineering page establish one qualifying department-hosted PhD. Other technical named doctoral specializations are not fully inventoried.

sources.note: Full official department page confirms exact title and PhD programme.
Full current rolling admissions brochure, particularly pages 8–10, confirms institute PhD and lists qualifying department plus Vinod Gupta School of Management.
Full business school PhD overview confirms generic management doctorate; no separately named eligible field on the opened page.

limitations: Source-bounded current university-wide formal field inventory incomplete; do not treat this one verified route as a completed census.
The two reported OM List faculty doctorate claims have not been independently checked in Stage 1.
